## fhir_capabilities

Read a server's [CapabilityStatement](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/capabilitystatement.html) (`GET /metadata`) and list each resource type it exposes together with the REST interactions supported for that type.

### Usage

Call it with a FHIR R4 base URL to list every resource type the server exposes and the REST interactions it supports for each; runnable statements are attached as this function's examples.

### Notes

- `interactions` is a `VARCHAR[]`; `UNNEST` it to get one row per (resource type, interaction) pair.
- Use this first to discover what an unfamiliar EHR/FHIR endpoint supports before querying specific resource types.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List every resource type a FHIR server supports and the REST interactions available for each.","sql":"SELECT resource_type, interactions FROM fhir.main.fhir_capabilities('https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4');"},{"description":"Expand the supported REST interactions to one row per (resource type, interaction).","sql":"SELECT resource_type, UNNEST(interactions) AS interaction FROM fhir.main.fhir_capabilities('https://r4.smarthealthit.org');"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"resource_type","type":"VARCHAR","description":"A FHIR resource type the server exposes (e.g. Patient)."},{"name":"interactions","type":"VARCHAR[]","description":"REST interaction codes supported for that type (e.g. read, search-type, create)."}]
rows.vgi.title: Read FHIR Server Capabilities

rows: SELECT resource_type, UNNEST(interactions) AS interaction FROM fhir.main.fhir_capabilities('https://r4.smarthealthit.org');

## fhir_observations

List [Observation](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/observation.html) resources from a FHIR R4 server with the `valueQuantity` flattened into a numeric `value` plus `unit`, alongside status, code, display, effective time, and subject reference.

### Usage

Call it with a FHIR R4 base URL to list Observations with their numeric `value` and `unit` flattened out; runnable statements are attached as this function's examples.

Narrow to a single LOINC code with a raw `query` such as the heart-rate code, and keep only rows whose `value` is not null for numeric measurements.

### Notes

- Observations without a numeric `valueQuantity` (e.g. coded or string results) surface a **NULL** `value` rather than `0`.
- The `raw` column preserves the full Observation JSON, including components and reference ranges.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List numeric Observations with their code, value, and unit.","sql":"SELECT code, code_display, value, unit FROM fhir.main.fhir_observations('https://r4.smarthealthit.org') WHERE value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 20;"},{"description":"List body-weight Observations (LOINC 29463-7) on the public HAPI R4 server with their value, unit, and effective time.","sql":"SELECT id, value, unit, effective FROM fhir.main.fhir_observations('https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4', query := 'code=29463-7') LIMIT 20;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"id","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Logical id of the Observation resource."},{"name":"status","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Observation status such as final, preliminary, or amended."},{"name":"code","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Primary observation code (e.g. the LOINC code from code.coding[0])."},{"name":"code_display","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Human-readable display text for the code."},{"name":"value","type":"DOUBLE","description":"Numeric valueQuantity.value; NULL for non-numeric observations."},{"name":"unit","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Unit of the value (valueQuantity.unit)."},{"name":"effective","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Effective date/time of the observation."},{"name":"subject","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Reference to the subject (usually Patient/{id})."},{"name":"raw","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The full Observation resource as a JSON string."}]
rows.vgi.title: List FHIR Observation Resources

## fhir_patients

List [Patient](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/patient.html) resources from a FHIR R4 server with the most-used demographic fields flattened into columns, while still returning the full resource JSON.

### Usage

Call it with a FHIR R4 base URL to list Patients with their core demographic fields flattened into columns; runnable statements are attached as this function's examples.

Filter server-side with a raw `query` (e.g. `family=smith`), set the page size with `count`, and authenticate with `token`.

### Notes

- One row per Patient across all Bundle pages (`next` links are followed automatically).
- The `raw` column carries the untouched Patient JSON for fields not flattened here.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List Patients with their core demographic fields flattened into columns.","sql":"SELECT id, family, given, gender, birth_date FROM fhir.main.fhir_patients('https://r4.smarthealthit.org') LIMIT 20;"},{"description":"List Patients with family name Smith on the public HAPI R4 server.","sql":"SELECT id, family, given, birth_date FROM fhir.main.fhir_patients('https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4', query := 'family=Smith') LIMIT 20;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"id","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Logical id of the Patient resource."},{"name":"family","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Family (last) name from the first name entry."},{"name":"given","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Given (first) name(s) from the first name entry."},{"name":"gender","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Administrative gender: male, female, other, or unknown."},{"name":"birth_date","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD or a partial FHIR date)."},{"name":"active","type":"BOOLEAN","description":"Whether the Patient record is in active use."},{"name":"raw","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The full Patient resource as a JSON string."}]

## fhir_read

Read a single FHIR R4 resource by its type and logical id — a direct `GET /{type}/{id}` against the server (the FHIR [read](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/http.html#read) interaction).

### Usage

Call it with a FHIR R4 base URL, a resource type, and a logical id (for example `Patient` / `example`) to fetch that one resource as JSON; runnable statements are attached as this function's examples.

### Notes

- Returns exactly one row when the resource exists; a missing resource (HTTP 404) surfaces as a query error rather than an empty result.
- Supply `token` for endpoints that require authentication.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Read the canonical FHIR example Patient (logical id 'example') and return its full JSON.","sql":"SELECT resource FROM fhir.main.fhir_read('https://r4.smarthealthit.org', 'Patient', '45a69bf0-7116-4f9f-a1d9-29700439b4a4');"}]
rows.vgi.keywords: ["fhir","read","read resource","get by id","single resource","logical id","resource json"]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"resource","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The requested resource as a JSON string."}]
rows.vgi.title: Read FHIR Resource By Id

## fhir_search

Run a FHIR R4 [search](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/search.html) over a single resource type and return one row per matched resource.

### Usage

Call it with a FHIR R4 base URL and a resource type (for example `Condition`) to return one row per matched resource; runnable statements are attached as this function's examples.

Pass a raw `query` (e.g. `name=smith&_count=50`) and/or `count` to refine the search, and `token` for protected servers.

### Notes

- Follows Bundle `next` links across pages until exhausted or the safety cap is reached.
- The `resource` column holds the complete resource JSON, so any field not surfaced by the flattened functions is still reachable via `json_extract`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the ids of all Condition resources on a FHIR R4 server (paging through Bundle next links).","sql":"SELECT id FROM fhir.main.fhir_search('https://r4.smarthealthit.org', 'Condition') LIMIT 20;"},{"description":"Search Patients named 'smith' on the public HAPI R4 server, 100 per page, returning id plus the raw resource JSON.","sql":"SELECT id, resource FROM fhir.main.fhir_search('https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4', 'Patient', query := 'name=smith', count := 100);"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"id","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Logical id of the matched FHIR resource."},{"name":"resource","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The full matched resource as a JSON string."}]
rows.vgi.title: Search FHIR Resource Type
